setup: The variant's implementation/ tree with its package.json (typecheck script present).
expected: tsc exits 0 with zero type errors.
pass: 1.0 if exit 0 and zero errors, else 0.0. A 0.0 here must be surfaced prominently.

setup: All functions across the variant's src/*.ts.
action: Compute per-function cyclomatic complexity via the configured metric source.
expected: No function exceeds warn (10); none exceeds fail (15).
pass: 1.0 if all <=warn; linear penalty per function between warn and fail; any function >=15 caps this sub-score at 0.4.

setup: The import graph of the variant's src/ modules.
action: Compute import fan-out per module and detect import cycles.
expected: No module imports more than 8 others; no import cycles exist.
pass: 1.0 if no module exceeds fan-out and no cycles; 0.0 on any import cycle.

setup: All src/*.ts files in the variant (S1 files are 8-98 lines).
expected: No src/*.ts file exceeds 200 lines (catches god-modules early).
pass: 1.0 if all files <=200 lines; linear penalty otherwise.

setup: Show the judge the S1 anchor files (vault.ts, search.ts) as the style baseline, then the variant's new/changed S1.5 files (e.g. sessions/recent/instrument/enrichment modules).
action: Judge naming, comment quality (comments explain WHY, like the S1 FTS AND-tokenization and YAML-date coercion notes), and structural clarity relative to the anchor.
expected: New/changed code matches or exceeds the S1 readability style.
pass: Judge returns 0..1 against the anchor; <0.5 is a readability fail. Weighted at 0.20 so a subjective judge cannot alone sink a clean variant.
